symptom: create or modify external entity declaring OrderId: String(20) on an Edm.Int64 property keeps RemoteType Edm.Int64; mx check CE6616
cause: carryStoredAttributeState carries RemoteType by name regardless of the declared type
fix: Refuse under mdl 1 (MDL-V1-REMOTETYPE), warn under mdl 0
insight: CE6616 compares against the service's $metadata, not the stored RemoteType, so deriving RemoteType from the declared type would not fix it; measured with mx check on a TestApp copy
